channel.title: Crypto Research Notes
channel.description: Original long-form research on crypto research methodology, on-chain data analysis, tokenomics, smart contract security, DAO governance, oracles, cross-chain bridge security, and Sybil address detection. For learning and research only — not investment advice.

item.title: On-Chain Forensics and Fund-Tracing Methodology: Where Did Stolen Funds Go
item.description: A methodology breakdown of on-chain forensics: how address clustering works and where it fails, why mixers and privacy protocols break traceability, the mechanics of cross-chain fund tracing, and how to identify cash-out nodes. Not investment advice.

item.title: Agent Audit Log Integrity Verification: The Log Says What It Did - Who Proves It Wasn't Altered
item.description: AI x On-Chain series (8): verifying the tamper-resistance of an AI agent's audit logs - integrity proofs, silent-deletion detection, trustworthy timestamp sourcing and independent attestation. Not investment advice.

item.title: Agent Strategy Execution Verification: Who Actually Checks 'Followed the Strategy'
item.description: AI x On-Chain series (7): verifying an AI trading/asset-management agent's claim to "strictly follow its strategy" - whether the strategy description is precise enough to audit, consistency between disclosed rules and actual orders, detection lag for out-of-bounds trades, whether stop-losses actually fire in a real drawdown, and a reusable checklist. Not investment advice.

item.title: Agent Identity and Credential Verification: Is This Identity Still Valid
item.description: AI x On-Chain series (6): a deep dive into AI agent identity and credential systems - the trust basis of decentralized identifiers, issuer credibility, revocation and key-rotation lag risk, and a reusable verification checklist. Not investment advice.

item.title: Agent Service Marketplace Verification: Whose Quote Can You Trust
item.description: AI x On-Chain series (5): AI agent service marketplaces — manipulation surfaces in bidding, verifiability of service quality and SLAs, reputation score credibility, neutrality of matching rules, and a reusable verification checklist. Not investment advice.

item.title: Agent-to-Agent Settlement Verification: Where the Credit Chain Breaks
item.description: AI x On-Chain series (4): agent economy structure, delegated authority cascades, runaway call loops, agent identity and reputation, and who has final say when settlement disputes arise. Not investment advice.

item.title: zkML and Trusted On-Chain Model Execution: Proving It Ran Isn't Proving It Ran Correctly
item.description: AI x On-Chain series (3): zkML trust shift, circuit quantization cost, and why a correct proof is not a correct judgment. Not investment advice.

item.title: AI Oracles and Trusted On-Chain Data: When a Model Produces "Truth," Who Verifies It
item.description: AI x On-Chain series (2): how AI oracles turn model output into on-chain truth, manipulation risks, and a verification checklist. Not investment advice.

item.title: On-Chain AI Agent Verification: When Automation Holds Your Keys, Who Sets the Limits
item.description: AI x On-Chain series (1): custody risk of AI agents, key limits, traceability, prompt-injection risk, plus a verification checklist. Not investment advice.

item.title: Prediction Market Resolution Risk: Who Actually Holds Final Authority
item.description: A deep dive into prediction market resolution: propose-and-dispute mechanics, adjudicator verification, and manipulation-cost stress tests.

item.title: Credit Pool Tranche Risk: What Does a Senior Share Actually Get You
item.description: A deep dive into real-world credit pools: senior/junior tranche loss order, default-rate verification, borrower due-diligence checks, and stress testing.

item.title: Decentralized Options Vaults: The Stable Weekly Yield Is Actually a Tail-Risk Premium
item.description: A deep dive into decentralized options vaults: covered calls, cash-secured puts, APY verification, and strike/delta checks.

item.title: Perpetual DEX Vaults: LPs Aren't Bystanders — They're the Counterparty to Every Trade
item.description: A deep dive into perpetual DEX vaults: why LPs are the direct counterparty to every trade, verifying disclosed APY, and checking skew and hedging controls.

item.title: Vote-Escrow Token Locks: Does the Claimed Lock Duration Actually Remove Supply from Circulation
item.description: A deep dive into vote-escrow (ve) locks: on-chain facts vs marketing claims, liquid wrapper risk, voting power vs economic alignment, unlock-cliff mapping.

item.title: Auto-Deleveraging: When the Insurance Fund Runs Dry, Whose Position Gets Closed
item.description: A deep dive into auto-deleveraging (ADL): the liquidation waterfall's last defense, why profitable positions close first, and how to verify insurance fund size.

item.title: Liquid Staking Tokens: Why the Derivative Token's Price Isn't Always Equal to the Underlying Staked Asset
item.description: A deep dive into liquid staking token price deviation: redemption queue vs secondary-market liquidity, slashing risk pass-through, and operator concentration.

item.title: RWA Tokenization: The On-Chain Token Is Just a Pointer to an Off-Chain Asset
item.description: A deep dive into RWA tokenization's trust structure: legal claim strength, custodian verification, supply-to-asset matching, and liquidity mismatch run risk.

item.title: MEV and Private Order Flow: The Sandwich Attack Didn't Disappear, It Just Changed Hands
item.description: A deep dive into MEV and private order flow: sandwich attack mechanics, builder concentration under PBS, and how to verify where extracted value goes.

item.title: Funding Rate Divergence: The Most Misread Signal in Perpetual Futures

item.title: Verifying Stablecoin Pegs: Does the Redemption Path Actually Deliver on the $1 Promise

item.title: Verifying On-Chain Insurance: Coverage Looks Broad Until You File a Claim
item.description: A methodology guide to on-chain insurance: verifying coverage triggers, claims-paying capacity, underwriter yield, and claims-arbitration governance.

item.title: Verifying Restaking: How Slashing Risk Stacks When One Collateral Backs Multiple Protocols

item.title: Verifying Swap Routing: What Costs Hide Behind the “Best Path” Quote

item.title: Liquidity Mining Yield: How Much Does Impermanent Loss Eat Into That APY

item.title: Verifying NFT Floor Price: One Wash Trade Can Inflate the “Floor” by Multiples
item.description: A methodology guide to verifying NFT rarity, wash trading, floor-price depth, and royalty enforcement.

item.title: Verifying Lending Liquidation: How One Oracle Delay Triggers a Cascade
item.description: A methodology guide to verifying lending-protocol liquidation parameters, bot economics, and cascading risk. Not investment advice.

item.title: Verifying DEX Liquidity: Beyond the TVL Number, What Is an AMM Pool's Real Depth
item.description: How to verify true AMM pool depth, calculate price impact and slippage, and understand the mechanism categories behind MEV and sandwich attacks.

item.title: Verifying Airdrop Distribution: A High Address Count Can Still Be One Person's Sybil Farm

item.title: Cross-Chain Bridges: Assets Never Actually Cross — They're Locked on One Side, Minted on the Other

item.title: Researching Team Background and Developer Activity: From Verifying Team Pages to Reading GitHub Signals

item.title: What Proof of Reserves Actually Proves: A Merkle Tree Verifies Inclusion, Not Solvency

item.title: DAO Governance: When Voting Power Concentrates in a Few Addresses, Does “Decentralized” Still Hold
item.description: How to research DAO governance: proposal lifecycles, voting power and delegation, and verifying treasury multisig/timelock configuration on-chain.

item.title: An Audit Report Says “Audited” — But Audited What, Exactly: From Conclusions to On-Chain Verification

item.title: Tokenomics Research: How Much Unlock Pressure Hides Behind the Circulating Supply Number

item.title: Paying for Crypto Research Tool Subscriptions: A Practical Guide to Virtual Credit Cards

item.title: Crypto Project Research Methodology: Why a Single Source Is Never Enough
item.description: A reusable framework for researching crypto projects: sources, fundamentals, tokenomics, and on-chain data, checked against a risk list.

item.title: On-Chain Data Analysis: An Address Is Not an Identity, a Transaction Is Not Intent
item.description: A walkthrough of on-chain metrics: active addresses, volume, TVL, holder concentration, exchange flows, and stablecoin supply, and how to read them correctly.

item.title: Stablecoins, Cross-Chain Bridges, and On-Chain Fund Flows: A Researcher's View of Asset Movement
